evals.name: ajk-portal
evals.prompt: Can we add the AJK procurement portal (ajkppra.gov.pk) as a source? Check it and add it if it's worth it.
evals.expected_output: Probes the official AJK page, checks robots/access, runs a relevance test on real notices, then either builds a collector (RawItems for every notice, item_to_leads, fixture, tests, registry Live) or records 'Not worth it' with numbers. Report in the skill's format.
expectations: Probed the official AJK page and reported the robots.txt / access finding
Ran a relevance test on real AJK notices and reported matches as a count out of the total checked
Stated a clear decision (built / not built) with the registry status
If built: collector stores every notice as a RawItem, has a fixture with URL+date, and the full test suite passes; if not built: registry row updated with evidence and date
Every notice title quoted in the report is a real title from the AJK site (no invented examples)
The main project folder was not modified (only the worktree and the outputs folder)

evals.name: isdb-check
evals.prompt: Someone in BD says the Islamic Development Bank posts tenders we could bid on. Check if we can get those into the app.
evals.expected_output: Finds the official IsDB procurement URL from an official page (no guessed domain), checks access and Pakistan/communications relevance, and records the outcome in source_registry.csv with evidence; builds only if allowed and relevant.
expectations: Identified the IsDB procurement URL and confirmed it on an official IsDB page (no guessed domain)
Checked robots.txt / terms / access for that page
Measured or explained relevance to Pakistan and communications work, with numbers or concrete evidence
Updated the isdb row in source_registry.csv from Unchecked to a status with evidence and date, and `sources validate` passes
Built a collector only if access was allowed and relevance was shown
